prose: Apple launched its first paid Apple Intelligence add-on: a one-time $49.99 'intelligence usage pack' in Logic Pro, available when you reach your monthly limit. Unused usage rolls over and expires after 12 months, does not support Family Sharing and works only for the buying iCloud account. 9to5Mac says Apple has long said expanded usage would eventually cost money, and more apps will follow.
highlights: First paid Apple Intelligence usage pack, $49.99 one-time
Used only after the monthly limit
Rolls over, expires after 12 months, no Family Sharing
Tied to Apple Creator Studio apps, more coming
